output.review_comment: The rounding behavior (round(seconds/60) instead of floor division) is unusual and potentially incorrect for a duration formatter. Similarly, removing the 24-hour wrapping (hours %= 24) contradicts the original design without clear justification. While the agent claims tests pass, these changes appear to be test-fitting rather than legitimate fixes. Please provide: (1) test output or test file showing expected behavior, (2) full docstring to verify no contradictions, (3) justification for rounding instead of truncating durations.
